name: Fiery Dragon
body:
Aura moderate evocation; CL 5th; Slot neck; Price 11,000 gp; Weight —.

DESCRIPTION

This tattoo is most often rendered with a red dragon entwined around the chest and shoulders.

The tattoo’s owner gains the following:

2/day: Breathe a 20 ft. cone of fire, doing 5d6 points of damage (DC 16 Reflex for half).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Craft Wondrous Tattoo, fireball; Cost 5,500 gp.
